code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (primary key). Seven non-standard codes exist; filter code_status = 'official_iso3166_1' for current ISO entries only.

name.description: Country name in World Bank style (e.g. 'Egypt, Arab Rep.'). English common names are in other_names (id 'en') and common_names.

iso3code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Join key for the borders field, which stores alpha-3 neighbor codes.

numeric_code.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code as a zero-padded string (e.g. '004').

capital_city.description: Capital or de facto seat of government with name and optional lat/lng coordinates. Absent by design for uninhabited territories and groupings.

region.description: World Bank region as {id, value} (e.g. id 'ECS'). Filter on id: value labels are inconsistent upstream (some carry an '(all income levels)' suffix). Absent for 8 entities the World Bank does not classify.

adminregion.description: World Bank administrative region as {id, value}. Only covers low- and middle-income economies; absence for high-income economies is expected.

incomeLevel.description: World Bank income classification as {id, value} (e.g. id 'HIC', value 'High income'). Absent for 8 unclassified entities.

lendingType.description: World Bank lending category as {id, value} (e.g. IBRD, IDA, Blend). Absent for 8 unclassified entities.

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata entity id (Q-number) for cross-referencing and entity linking.

official_name.description: Official long-form state name (e.g. 'Arab Republic of Egypt').

languages.description: Spoken/official languages as a list of {code, name, official} objects.

currencies.description: Circulating currencies as a list of {code, name, symbol} objects with ISO 4217 codes.

un_member.description: True when the entity is a United Nations member state. See un_status for the three-way member/observer/non_member distinction.

un_status.description: United Nations participation status: member (UN member state), observer (permanent observer state: PS, VA), or non_member. Must be consistent with un_member (member <=> un_member: true).

independent.description: True when the entity is a widely recognized sovereign state. Explicitly false on non-standard-code records (disputed territories, groupings).

subregion.description: UN M49 subregion label (e.g. 'South-Eastern Asia'). Statistical convenience only; implies no political affiliation.

continents.description: Continent names the entity belongs to (list; transcontinental states list several).

borders.description: Land border neighbors as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (e.g. CAN, MEX)

population.description: Population indicator struct {value, year, source, source_id}. Use .value for the number; year is null when the reference year is unknown (never 0).

area.description: Land area indicator struct {value, year, source, source_id} in square kilometres. Use .value for the number.

gini.description: Gini income-inequality index struct {value, year, source, source_id}. Sparse: roughly a third of records have no value.

native_names.description: Native-language names keyed by language code, each with official and common variants.

landlocked.description: True when the entity has no coastline. Non-ISO records may be landlocked with an empty borders list (borders holds alpha-3 codes only).

timezones.description: IANA/UTC timezone offsets covering the territory. Empty for uninhabited territories (see timezone_status).

timezone_status.description: Marker explaining an empty timezones list, e.g. 'not_applicable' for uninhabited territories.

calling_codes.description: International telephone calling codes (list of strings).

flag_emoji.description: Unicode flag emoji for the country code.

start_of_week.description: First day of the working week (e.g. 'monday', 'sunday').

demonyms.description: Demonyms as {female, male} strings in English.

other_names.description: Names in multiple languages (UN official languages)

common_names.description: Common English names and alternative names for the country

m49_code.description: UN M49 numeric code (3-digit code for countries)

entity_type.description: Entity classification: sovereign_state, dependent_territory, special_administrative_region, disputed_territory, historical_entity, supranational_grouping, or statistical_area.

code_status.description: Code assignment status: official_iso3166_1 (249 records), user_assigned, obsolete, or exceptionally_reserved. See docs/country-code-policy.md.

recognition_status.description: Recognition metadata for non-standard entities: {status, un_member, notes} explaining disputed, dissolved, or collective-grouping records.

parent_entity.description: Parent state {code, name} for dependent territories and special administrative regions.

provenance.description: Field-level sourcing entries {field, source, url, retrieved_at, license} documenting where enriched values came from.
